name: mtg-data
description: Magic: The Gathering tournament data and gameplay review, from the scrape through to the meta read. Four skills: mtg-tournament-analysis reads the format (meta share, win rates, matchup matrices, card-level signal), deck-check assigns archetype names and pushes them back into the numbers, vod-review breaks down your own games from an untapped.gg match log, a YouTube VOD or a pasted log, and rules-check answers rules questions by quoting the current Comprehensive Rules. vod-review interviews you about the decisions it flagged before it grades any of them, asks whether the archetype's key and rogue cards were in your decision tree, and logs every finding to an append-only play ledger. play_profile.py counts that ledger into a play profile: leaks and strengths named from a fixed pattern registry, each with the count, the dates and a citation back to the review note behind it, a bar of three occurrences across two sessions, one bucket per pattern so nothing is a leak and a strength at once, pace measured from VOD timestamps or per-game duration rather than guessed at, and a discount flag on any pattern found mostly because the profile predicted it. Local-first: Playwright scrapers pull melee.gg and MTGO onto your own machine, format eras keep pre-ban results out of post-ban numbers, and your play ledger never leaves your machine. Run setup.py once after install to build the per-format folder tree and wire up scraping.
